name: Dorothy Davenport
original_name: ドロシー・ダヴェンポート
source:
Specialty: Making apple pie
Likes: Japan's otakus
Dislikes: Crowded trains, being quiet, the summer heat

A British foreign exchange student who came to live with the Sawataris, and acts as their maid, referring to Rei as "Master" and Michiru as "Mistress". Born and raised in Britain, her grandfather was Japanese, effectively making her a quarter-Japanese herself, and through him, Dorothy got interested in Japan. In order to learn the language and culture of Japan, she constantly searched the Internet, but became especially interested in the otaku culture. Loves Japanese food above all else, since it doesn't fatten her up no matter how much she eats it. Frequently mixes English words into her speech.

"The food back home's such utter shite! Japanese and Chinese food's just marvelous!"
